summary: Milestone 2026.05.228 was a planning-only milestone: 0 experiments completed, 0 wall-time minutes of experiment execution, and both RTX 3090 GPUs remained idle at 0% utilization throughout. No experiment commits were found since activation; the milestone produced a 14-task roadmap (exp2322-exp2335) but did not advance to the execution phase within this retrospective window.
bottlenecks_identified: No experiments executed during milestone window — seventh consecutive milestone with 0 completed experiments. The pre-test cascade (exp2323 Claude-escalated fix) is the structural blocker gating all Phase 1-3 tasks.

The planning-to-execution gap persists: roadmap generation completes but experiment activation has not occurred within the same milestone window, creating a recurring delay between plan and execution.
exp2323 (requires_claude: true, pre-test fix v9) gates 11 of 14 tasks in the roadmap — a single point of failure that propagates to Phase 1, 2, 3, and the capstone.
improvements_suggested: Ensure exp2323 (pre-test fix) is the FIRST task activated immediately upon milestone open, not queued behind the archive step — activation latency compounds the planning-only pattern.

Consider decoupling at least one Phase 1 or Phase 2 task from the pre-test gate for milestones where the gate has been the sole blocker for 7+ consecutive milestones; a parallel ungated smoke-test would confirm GPU and model-load health independently.

Add a conductor-side pre-activation smoke-test that verifies the pre-test suite state BEFORE activating the milestone — if the suite is already broken, emit a blocked_pretest_cascade artifact immediately rather than discovering it mid-milestone.

Document the potts artifact status (results/experiment_1692_potts_export.json) and xdist group marking fixes in known-issues.md with specific remediation steps, so they are not re-diagnosed from scratch in .229.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Execute exp2323 (Claude-escalated pre-test fix v9, max_turns:50) as the very first task at .228 activation — this single task unblocks 11 of 14 downstream tasks and ends the 7-milestone pre-test cascade.

Add a conductor activation-time pre-test smoke check: before activating any compute-bound Phase 1-3 task, run `pytest tests/ -x --ignore=tests/e2e -q` and emit a structured blocked_pretest artifact if it fails — this converts silent cascade failures into immediate honest verdicts.

Restore the missing results/experiment_1692_potts_export.json artifact (required by exp2323 step 0 precondition) either by regenerating it or by updating the test fixture to use a mock — removing this dependency from the critical path reduces the pre-test fix scope.
meta_reflection: Seven consecutive planning-only milestones signal a process failure, not a research one: the conductor is generating high-quality roadmaps but the execution phase is being blocked at the first gate before any experiment runs. The meta-lesson is that a gating task with 8 consecutive failures (exp2267/2281/2295/2309 and predecessors) must be treated as a structural blocker requiring escalation priority — not just another slot in the roadmap. Operational improvement requires decoupling milestone health from any single gating task.
